Unterhalb dieses Strompreises wird die B: Below this electricity price the battery is not used for short-term grid balance. From this threshold upward, grid balance may write (house load minus PV plus SOC offset) to control.discharge. Remaining PV forecast and battery capacity are not a gate.
Gemeinsamer Contract für Heizstab, Klima: Shared contract for immersion, climate and wallbox. The Operator sees Hold (EVCC/intent) and only releases battery energy when policy and SOC floor allow — no fighting EVCC. Live status: planner.constraints.battery_consumer_*_allowed / reason_de.
Max. Entladeleistung für Verbraucher (W,: Max discharge power for consumers (W, optional)

Export-Datei in den Restore-Inbox-Ordner: Place the export file into the restore inbox folder and run Restore in Admin — mappings and learning will return. Details: docs/EMS_LIGHT_FRESH_INSTALL_CHECKLIST.md
So starten Sie: 1) Geräte-Mappings setze: How to start: 1) Set device mappings (which ioBroker states EMS may read/write). 2) Keep each device on dryrun until everything looks right. 3) Only then switch to live. dryrun = EMS plans and shows but does not write devices. live = writes allowed. Both global and per-add-on must be live, otherwise it stays dryrun. AI optimization (later) also needs “AI optimization allowed” per add-on.
Der schwere Planner-Shadow/Takeover-Pfad: The heavy planner shadow/takeover path is disabled in this production build. EMS controls via failsafe + daily-plan logic. Later, AI can optimize plans per add-on (with clearance) — without writing devices directly.
EMS-Light funktioniert vollständig ohne: EMS-Light works fully without AI. When enabled, AI may only suggest optimizations for add-ons that are enabled AND individually cleared via “AI optimization allowed” below — it never writes to devices and never changes policies. Only triggered on a new daily plan (not every tick) or via the button below. Cost estimate is approximate (built-in price list, not live billing).
Wird verschlüsselt gespeichert und nie i: Stored encrypted and never included in backup/support exports.
Soft-Warnung ab 80% des Limits. Jeder Au: Soft warning from 80% of the limit. Every call (including errors) counts.
Automatische Aufrufe (bei relevanter Tag: Automatic calls (on a relevant daily plan change) fire at the earliest after this much time since the last automatic call. 0 = no minimum interval (only the change matters). Does not affect the manual "Optimize now" button.
Löst sofort einen einzelnen KI-Versuch a: Immediately triggers a single AI attempt (counts against the daily limit) — for testing. Result under ai.* in the object tree.
KI-Versuch abgeschlossen — Details unter: AI attempt completed — details under ai.* in the object tree
KI-Versuch fehlgeschlagen — Details unte: AI attempt failed — details under ai.last_error
Zeigt Status, Aufrufe heute, Kostenschät: Shows status, calls today, cost estimate — without triggering a call.
Status gelesen — Details unter ai.* im O: Status read — details under ai.* in the object tree
Plan A (deterministisch) ist der Plan, d: Plan A (deterministic) is the plan EMS actually executes — this does NOT change here. Plan B is a pure observation simulation: it shows how the AI's suggested time preferences (only for add-ons cleared here, immersion heater/climate only) would change grid draw/cost — using the exact same amount of energy, just at different times. Without AI (or without clearance) Plan B is identical to Plan A.
Für VIS/Grafiken: compare.plan_a.chart_j: For VIS/charts: compare.plan_a.chart_json and compare.plan_b.chart_json (each [{t,pv_w,grid_w,ih_w,ac_w,price_ct}, …], same time axis — two curves in a History/Flot widget). compare.active_plan (a/b) and compare.delta_summary_json contain the summary (cost/PV/grid/unallocated per plan). Note: ih_w/ac_w only show the flexible, shiftable power — safety-mandatory cycles (e.g. anti-legionella) are deliberately excluded and keep running exactly as planned.
Zeigt, welcher Plan rechnerisch günstige: Shows which plan would be cheaper on paper — does not trigger a recalculation (that runs automatically on every new daily plan).
Status gelesen — Details unter compare.*: Status read — details under compare.* in the object tree
Aus: nur Alltag (Jetzt / Demnächst / Add: Off: everyday view only (Now / Next / add-ons). On: also show AI, plan and detail reasons at the bottom of the VIS board.
Fester Anlagenwert in ct/kWh (z. B. 9,3): Fixed site value in ct/kWh (e.g. 9.3). No conversion from €/kWh — 9.3 means 9.3 ct/kWh. Empty = planner without a known feed-in tariff (existing fallback).
Vergütung für ins öffentliche Netz einge: Compensation for PV energy exported to the public grid. Used by the planner as opportunity cost for PV energy. Unit: ct/kWh.
